rationale: Depth-limited single tree. Kept for explanation rather than accuracy: the printed splits show the learned thresholds in a form a non-technical stakeholder can read.
known_limitations: Trained on synthetic data; coefficients should not be read as real-world effects.
tenure_years carries no signal in this dataset and may in reality; revisit before relying on it.
Cost assumptions (FP/FN) are placeholders and drive the recommended threshold.
